settings.bounces: FPT scene/config default; metadata records effective configuration

authored_retry.first_result: Metal accumulation chunk failed at sample 10 row 96: GPU recovery InnocentVictim

white_geometry_controls.finding: All three retain structural/composition mismatches after disabling volumes, AO, specular/reflection, DOF and palette colour in native controls.

limitations: Manual inspection of native CPU authored / FPT neutral geometry / FPT authored sheets.
coarse_match refers only to large-scale structure/framing at 300 maximum axis, not exact geometry parity.
Appearance labels are qualitative, not thresholds derived from global MAE.
Additional native white controls for 25, 38 and 48 disable fog, AO, specular, reflection, DOF and palette colour without changing camera/formulas; direct lighting is not matched to FPT.
Only ranked 50 audited; this is not current validation of the full 746-scene corpus or arbitrary Mandel scenes.
Native references retain authored Monte Carlo/DOF sample settings; 32 SPP applies only to FPT.
No CVOX/NAADF export gate was run in this audit.
Capture wall time is not a performance benchmark.
Only AO external maps were fingerprinted.
Fog/cloud implementation remains out of scope; appearance gaps are still recorded.

reviews.notes: Pit, terrace and plane framing align. FPT lacks the native reference's bright white foreground and has different pit shading.
Major lobes and framing align; coloured AO restores the warm palette. Highlights, valley contrast and small-scale surface response still differ.
Cube silhouette, cutouts and ribbed face align. FPT is yellow/cream rather than the reference's cool pale blue.
Cylinder crop, top bands and strong red/blue material bands align; residual shading and fine pattern differences remain.
Room walls and openings align. FPT is noticeably darker, especially the foreground floor and recessed regions.
Diagonal channels and terraces align. Native depth-of-field blur is absent and FPT has darker, warmer shading.
The perforated cube is present in the neutral view. Native luminous clouds and their illumination are absent; FPT authored is nearly black.
The neutral view retains the curved stalks and petals seen in the native reference. The authored FPT render is effectively black despite an OK execution status.
FPT neutral geometry is visible but authored output is nearly black. Native CPU reference timed out at 900 seconds; current-checkpoint reference fidelity cannot be assessed.
Curved plates, thin strands and framing align. The authored FPT view is substantially darker than the native gold/blue reference.

The overall close-up composition is similar, but the brightly shaded reference lobes are hard to reconcile with the neutral facets at this resolution. FPT authored is much darker; isolated depth/normal comparison is needed before claiming geometry parity.
Symmetric silhouette, lobes and internal layering align. FPT is smoother and less contrasty; fine highlights differ.
All four loop shapes align. FPT material bands and background are substantially brighter.
Repeated towers, holes and ground framing align in neutral mode. FPT authored is almost black instead of the bright red reflective reference.
Silhouette and main openings align. FPT loses contrast in inner green recesses and has softer details.
Outer frame and openings align; FPT adds bright green interior illumination where the native reference is dark.
Both FPT modes completed with visible structure. The fresh native CPU reference timed out at 900 seconds, so it is not assessed against an older substituted image.
Large spherical surface, supports and framing align. FPT authored lacks the strong blue illumination and is substantially darker.
Rounded labyrinth silhouette and grooves align. FPT red material has much weaker highlights and flatter lighting.
Tunnel framing and major wall cutouts align. FPT authored has reduced contrast and visibly noisy/dark lower walls; fine cavity agreement needs a neutral reference.
Main ridges, arches and viewpoint are recognizable in the neutral view. FPT authored is almost black instead of the bright pink native global-illumination render.
Framing is similar, but native reflective highlights obscure direct geometry comparison. FPT retains only a few bright regions and loses much of the native foreground lighting/pattern.
Framing and major bulb-like corner structures align. FPT authored is nearly black; native patterned walls and blue/white illumination are largely missing.
Spherical columns and ceiling layout align in neutral mode. FPT authored loses the bright yellow/white highlights and atmospheric depth, leaving a much darker view.
Fog-free, white-material native control retains curved ring/arm structures; FPT instead shows a dense cross/grid of spheres. Structural/composition mismatch persists without fog, AO or reflections.
Tilted cylinder, ribbed ends and central pattern align. FPT is brighter, especially along the pale end bands.
Central arch, room layout and floor framing are recognizable. FPT authored loses most bright gold/pink lighting and reflections.
Ring silhouette, hole and main bead-like structures align. FPT lacks the reference's strong highlights and contrast.
Large block/corridor framing is recognizable. FPT authored lacks the orange volume/light response and is nearly black.
Neutral mode retains the chamber's sphere columns and floor/ceiling framing. FPT authored loses nearly all patterned surfaces, leaving a dim field and a few white pixels.

Neutral geometry and successful retry retain the native towers and ledge. FPT highlights are weaker. Original authored attempt hit Metal GPU-recovery InnocentVictim; identical-settings retry passed, but recurrence is not ruled out.
Native volumetric/reflection/DOF effects obscure a fair geometry comparison. Neutral FPT shows major spheres and sparse thin structures, while authored FPT is almost black.
Looped pipes, symmetry and foreground framing align. FPT authored is much darker and lacks native metallic highlights.
Sphere columns and repeated cubic details align in the neutral view. FPT authored is much darker and omits most gold/white specular response.
Main perforated blocks and detached frame pieces align. FPT is brighter with different shading and local surface contrast.
Symmetric curved plates and central fine structures align. FPT introduces strong pink/cyan surface colours where the reference is predominantly pale gold/white.
Large bowl-like forms and curved stems have matching placement. FPT authored is very dark purple; the native pink fog and distant illumination are absent, so far-field detail is not certified.

Fog-free native control retains separated twisting columns and open gaps. FPT instead shows dense geometry and a narrow horizon gap. Structural/composition mismatch persists without volume/light effects.
Central column, repeated platforms and curved supports align. FPT is much darker, with weak native pale highlights and pink floor response.
Large panels, sphere clusters and tunnel framing are recognizable. Native bright blue/pink orbit-trap/light effects are absent; FPT is dark and essentially greyscale.
Receding perforated blocks, framing and red/green/yellow palette align closely. Local brightness and small detail differences remain.
Large rounded forms and crater/ring placements align. FPT loses the native bright blue/white material response and is mostly dark grey/red.
Central opening and surrounding faceted structure align. FPT is darker and its inner colour/illumination differs.
Triangular framework, arches and framing align. FPT yellow material is substantially brighter and loses native midtone contrast.
Lobed silhouette, grooves and orange/red appearance align closely. Groove contrast and highlight shape still differ.

Some box placement is recognizable, but large lit/fog regions are replaced by black or a flat cyan patch. A fog-free geometry reference is needed; the authored iteration-fog scene is not visually supported.
Repeated rings and curved structures align in neutral mode. Native pale gold/pink and blue illumination is largely absent in the dark FPT authored image.

White native control retains a large plane, thin supports and foreground structures; FPT is almost empty. Source camera-to-target distance is about 3e-8 at coordinates near 20. Precision/deep-zoom handling is a hypothesis, not an established cause.
Both FPT modes render a populated cavern. Fresh native reference timed out; the historically mismatched duplicate-filename reference was deliberately not substituted.
Tall prism placement and smaller floor blocks align. FPT lacks native depth-of-field blur and blue/grey material response, and has noisy bright floor illumination.
